Package edu.secourse.patientportal.model

Class Appointment

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.model.Appointment
@Entity public class Appointment extends Object
Represents a scheduled appointment between a Patient and Doctor.

Mapped to the appointments table. The patient and doctor fields are foreign-key references to the patients and doctors tables respectively, expressed via ManyToOne associations.

      public Appointment()

    • Appointment

      public Appointment(Patient patient, Doctor doctor, LocalDateTime appointmentDateTime)
      Constructs an Appointment given a patient, doctor, and scheduled time. The end time is automatically set to 30 minutes after the start time. If any argument is null, the default values are retained.
      Parameters:
      patient - the patient associated with the appointment
      doctor - the doctor associated with the appointment
      appointmentDateTime - the date and time the appointment starts
